query:
SELECT 
  ve.eventType, ve.page, ve.referrer, ve.country, ve.device, ve.browser, 
  ve.sessionId, ve.createdAt
FROM visitor_events ve
WHERE ve.userId = 1650001
ORDER BY ve.createdAt ASC;
